To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a three-layer game named KDGAM consisting of a classifier and a teacher trained via distillation losses as well as a discriminator trained via adversarial losses, where we approximate the discrete distributions learned by the classifier and the teacher with continuous concrete distributions to speed up the training.

(1) we propose KDGAN, a novel three-player game for knowledge distillation; (2) we approximate the discrete distribution with a continuous one to obtain low-variane gradient updates; (3) extensive experiments using real datasets show that KDGAN achieves higher accuracy and training speed than the existing methods.
KDGAN can be used to train classifiers with higher accuracy and faster training speed than the state-of-the-art methods.
